recommended_approach: Mantaflow GAS “Multi-Flow Domain” campfire (separate flow emitters for flame/smoke) + Wind/Turbulence force fields for motion art-direction + Principled Volume shader for fire/smoke rendering

Fluid modifier (flow object).flow_settings (fs).flow_type: 'SMOKE' (use an additional fire-capable flow for flames in the same domain if desired)

Mantaflow domain (settings).domain_settings (ds).cache_directory: Set explicitly (e.g. env BLENDER_CACHE_DIR or '/tmp/blender_cache') for reliable bakes/exports

warnings: Mantaflow cache management: set an explicit domain cache directory (ds.cache_directory) to avoid missing/unstable output paths (especially in headless/automated runs).

Campfire-specific pitfall indicated by available pattern metadata: smoke can accumulate and fill the whole domain; plan for dissipation/dissolve-style behavior or domain management so the sim doesn’t become a solid fog box.

Tooling note from doc search output: API reference pages for some Mantaflow properties may not be directly returned; rely on bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings / bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings plus UI inspection when wiring exact property names.
Force fields must be placed/aimed relative to the domain and flame column; excessive wind/turbulence strengths can destroy the coherent flame shape (start low and iterate).
alternative_approaches: Grease Pencil flames + Grease Pencil Visual Effect “Glow” for a stylized campfire look (no fluid sim), optionally used alongside conventional lighting to get the warm orange spill on grass.
